description: This header file declares functions, macros, and includes related to thermistor sensors, used for temperature measurement and conversion in an engine management system.

methods.name: getR1InVoltageDividor
methods.description: Calculates resistance R1 based on voltage divider measurements.

methods.name: getR2InVoltageDividor
methods.description: Calculates resistance R2 based on voltage divider measurements.

methods.name: getTempK
methods.description: Calculates Kelvin temperature from resistance.

methods.name: convertKelvinToCelcius
methods.description: Converts Kelvin temperature to Celsius.

methods.name: convertCelsiusToKelvin
methods.description: Converts Celsius temperature to Kelvin.

methods.name: convertCelciustoF
methods.description: Converts Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit.

methods.name: convertFtoCelcius
methods.description: Converts Fahrenheit temperature to Celsius.

methods.name: getKelvinTemperature
methods.description: Determines Kelvin temperature from resistance and thermistor math data.

methods.name: getResistance
methods.description: Calculates resistance based on voltage and thermistor configuration.

methods.name: getTemperatureC
methods.description: Gets temperature in Celsius based on configuration and resistance.

methods.name: getCoolantTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves coolant temperature from engine parameters.

methods.name: isValidCoolantTemperature
methods.description: Checks if coolant temperature value is valid.

methods.name: getIntakeAirTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves intake air temperature from engine parameters.

methods.name: isValidIntakeAirTemperature
methods.description: Checks if intake air temperature value is valid.

methods.name: hasIatSensor
methods.description: Determines if an Intake Air Temperature sensor is present.

methods.name: hasCltSensor
methods.description: Determines if a Coolant Temperature sensor is present.

methods.name: setThermistorConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for a thermistor.

methods.name: initThermistors
methods.description: Initializes thermistors with optional logging and engine parameters.

methods.name: setCommonNTCSensor
methods.description: Configures a thermistor as a common NTC sensor.

methods.name: setDodgeSensor
methods.description: Configures a thermistor as a Dodge-specific sensor.
